references.text: Earlier in the chapter, the command is given to divide the plunder into two halves between the warriors and the rest of the congregation, which this verse now carries out.
These verses list the total plunder that was taken, half of which is now assigned to the warriors as described in verse 36.
Describes the other half of the plunder that went to the congregation, in contrast to the warriors' share in verse 36.
Gives legislation on the distribution of war spoils, including small livestock, as background for the distribution described in Numbers 31.
Joshua gives similar instructions on dividing war spoils between those who went into battle and those who remained behind.
